CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2557,                                SHANGHAI,       4th August 1937.

Sir,

        With reference to former correspondence, your file
D.4841, 1935, regarding Szmul Mowsza DRINBERG, I have the
honour to inform you that this person arrived at Singapore
from Shanghai on board of the s.s. "Felix Roussel" on the
22nd June 1937. He intended to travel to the Netherlands
Indies and was still in possession of the Polish passport
Serie 1. No.414064 No.167/34, provided with a Netherlands
visé for travelling to the Netherlands Indies by the Nether-
lands Consulate-General at Paris on July 17th, 1936. Brin-
berg was brought to the notice of the Netherlands Consulate
at Singapore by the immigration authorities. On account of
the warning issued by this Consulate-General at December 11th
1935, Brinberg's visé was cancelled.
        Brinberg's family seems to be still residing at Shanghai
and he himself returned to Shanghai on board of the s.s.
"Yasukini Maru", leaving Singapore on the 9th July 1937.

                                                I have the honour to be,
                                                        Sir,
                                                Your obedient servant,

（印：mB / 6 AUG. 1937 / SHANGHAI）          Acting Consul-General.

Major K.M.Bourne,
Deputy Commissioner i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
        SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第2557号，                                上海，       1937年8月4日。

先生：

        关于此前往来信函，即贵处1935年D.4841号档案，涉及Szmul Mowsza DRINBERG一事，本人荣幸地通知您，此人于1937年6月22日乘坐“Felix Roussel”号轮船从上海抵达新加坡。他打算前往荷属东印度群岛，当时仍持有波兰护照，系列1，编号414064，签证号167/34，该护照已于1936年7月17日由荷兰驻巴黎总领事馆签发了前往荷属东印度群岛的荷兰签证。移民当局已将Brinberg的情况通报给荷兰驻新加坡领事馆。鉴于本总领事馆于1935年12月11日发出的警告，Brinberg的签证已被注销。
        Brinberg的家属似乎仍居住在上海，而他本人则于1937年7月9日离开新加坡，乘坐“Yasukini Maru”号轮船返回上海。

                                                谨此致意，
                                                        先生，
                                                您顺从的仆人，

（印：mB / 1937年8月6日 / 上海）          代理总领事。

K.M.Bourne少校，
特别处副处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
        上海。

（批：CSC / N... 转居留科 / D.B.R. / 8月7日）
（批：登记 / 详情已注 / Jo.P / 8月18日）

Shiciman的同伙之一，Shiciman经常往返于天津、大连和上海，指挥毒品从一地转运至另一地。1929年9月10日，Brinberg在天津被捕，当时警方在英国租界内发现一处房屋，里面设有精密的设备，用于从地板蜡中提取海洛因，毒品即以这种形式从法国装运。1931年，Brinberg居住在上海，他在法租界卡西尼路（Rue Cassini）225号拥有一家“蒸汽羽绒清洗厂”（Steam Downcleaning Factory）。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.

No.3768.

CONFIDENTIEEL

SHANGHAI, 22 November 1935.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 4841
Date 22 / 11 / 35）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Szmul Mowsza BRINBERG
has applied to me for a visé for admission into the Netherlands
Indies.

He is in possession of a Polish passport Ser.1.No.414064,
No.167/34, issued by the Polish Consulate at Shanghai on the 21st
November 1934.

According to his passport he was born at Pinsk (Poland) on
the 1st January 1882.

He states to be living at 146a Route des Soeurs and to have a
business in cushions and blankets. He wants to stay for 3-4
months in Java and to take for $ 10.000 goods with him.

Furthermore he intends to visit his niece Mrs.M.J.Mizrahi
née Rikoff, who is at present residing in Soerabaia.

With regard to Miss Rikoff I beg to refer to your secret
letter of the 27th November 1934,No.D.6254 in which you mentioned
that Brinberg was arrested for trafficking in narcotics by the
Police of the British Concession, Tientsin, on the 10th September
1929.

I should be much obliged to you if you could let me know,
if possible, whether Brinberg is still connected with the traffic
in narcotics and whether anything is known against him from a
political point of view.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

[签名]

Chinese Secretary.

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

SHANGHAI.

May 11 33

My dear Barton,

With reference to your letter of May 4, I have
to inform you that S. Brinberg, a Polish citizen who
has applied for a visa to visit Hong Kong, is identical
with S.M. Brinberg alias Bronberg alias Brenberg, a
suspected drug smuggler.

S.M. Brinberg and one J. Ifliand are reported
to be the proprietors of the Down Cleaning Factory,
No.225 Rue Cassini. Until recently Brinberg also kept
a haberdashery shop at 765 Avenue Joffre (old number 515)
under the style "J. Ifliand and S. Brinberg" which proved
a failure.

Brinberg is at present residing at No.42 Avenue
Victor Emmanuel III (Tel.70517).

Yours sincerely,

J. Barton, Esq.,
British Consulate-General.

Summary of activities of S.M. Brinberg
alias Bronberg Russian Jew

The above named first came to the notice of the
Shanghai Municipal Police in February 1922, when information
was received to the effect that he would arrive in Shanghai
from Trieste with a cargo of opium. The informer was
referred to the local Customs Authorities and it is not
known what actually transpired in regard to this matter.
(File I.C. 3078)

In 1928, Brinberg's name is mentioned in correspondence
between the Foreign Office, London, and the local British
Consul-General on the subject of illicit drug traffic in the
Far East. The paragraph regarding him reads as follows:

"S.M. Brinberg is one of the many associates of the
notorious F.V. Shichman; frequently travels to
Tientsin, Dairen and Shanghai, directing the
movements of drugs from one point to another; he
travelled to Germany sometime last year (1927?)
to make arrangements for the forwarding of drugs
to the Far East". (File No.I.O.9186/1)

On September 10, 1929, Brinberg was arrested in
Tientsin, when the Police discovered a house in the British
Concession containing an elaborate plant which was used for
extracting heroin from floor polish in which form drugs were
being shipped from France. The Tientsin Police did not
notify the S.M. Police what sentence was imposed in this case,
but in the "Elispoulos" file (C.& S.B. D.4236) under the name
of Brinberg it states: "He was arrested in 1930 as owner of
a small factory of narcotics in the French Concession
(Tientsin), was set free against a caution of Mex $3,000,
about £200 at that time." This apparently refers to the case
against him in Tientsin in September 1929. (File No. D.577)

On June 12, 1931 (1931) a letter was received from the
Chief of Police at Tientsin stating that Brinberg and one

上述人员首次引起上海公共租界工部局警务处注意是在1922年2月，当时收到情报称他将携带一批鸦片从的里雅斯特抵达上海。举报人被转介至当地海关当局，此事后续实际发展情况不详。（档案 I.C. 3078）

1928年，Brinberg的名字出现在英国外交部与伦敦当地总领事关于远东非法毒品贸易的通信中。关于他的段落如下：

“S.M. Brinberg是臭名昭著的F.V. Shichman的众多同伙之一；经常往返于天津、大连和上海，指挥毒品从一地转运至另一地；他去年（1927年？）某时前往德国，安排向远东输送毒品事宜”。（档案号 I.O.9186/1）

1929年9月10日，Brinberg在天津被捕，当时警方在英国租界内发现一处房屋，里面设有精密的设备，用于从地板蜡中提取海洛因，毒品即以这种形式从法国装运。天津警方未通知上海公共租界警务处此案判处何种刑罚，但在“Elispoulos”档案（C.& S.B. D.4236）中Brinberg名下记载：“他于1930年作为法租界（天津）一家小型毒品工厂的业主被捕，以3,000墨西哥元（当时约合200英镑）的保释金获释。”这显然指的是1929年9月在天津针对他的案件。（档案号 D.577）

1931年6月12日（1931年），收到天津警察局长来信，称Brinberg和一名

pages.en:
- 2 -

T. Ifliand, Russian Jew, had started a "steam Downcleaning
Factory" at No.225 Rue Cassini, French Concession, Shanghai.
The information was conveyed to the French Police, with the
result that they and a chemist of the F.M.C. visited the
factory and examined the "down" and machinery. Nothing,
however, was found to substantiate the suspicion that the
factory was engaged in producing morphine from chemicals
used in cleaning "down".

An extract from a report of the Narcotic Section
dated December 22, 1932, (see file No. D.4236) is quoted
hereunder:

S. Bronberg alias Semen Brinberg, short, stout, cast
in left eye is now residing in Shanghai and has a haberdashery
shop at 515 Avenue Joffre, French Concession. He is suspected
to be concerned in the smuggling of narcotics from Tientsin
with the aid of Mrs. Oder and a Mr. Diderich, both of Tientsin,
One Ifliand (file D.577) is believed to be his partner.
pages.zh:

T. Ifliand，俄籍犹太人，在上海法租界霞飞路（Rue Cassini）225号开办了一家“蒸汽羽绒清洗厂”。该情报已转交法国巡捕房，随后法警与法公董局（F.M.C.）的一名化学师前往该厂，检查了“羽绒”及机器设备。然而，并未发现任何证据证实该厂利用清洗“羽绒”所用的化学品生产吗啡的嫌疑。

S. Bronberg，又名 Semen Brinberg，身材矮胖，左眼斜视，现居住于上海，在法租界霞飞路515号拥有一家服饰用品店。涉嫌在天津的 Oder 太太和 Diderich 先生协助下，从天津走私麻醉品。一名 Ifliand（见档案 D.577）据信为其同伙。
